headline: Nikkei 225 Falls 6% Following Wall Street Tech Sell-Off
summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 index dropped 6% amid growing concerns over technology investments and spillovers from a sharp Wall Street sell-off following the U.S. midterm elections.
why: Global equity markets often exhibit high correlation during technology sector corrections, with export-oriented Asian indices reacting quickly to U.S. macro and tech sentiment.

impacts.name: Nikkei 225
impacts.why: The Nikkei 225 fell 6% due to tech-related declines spilling over from Wall Street.
